answer: Random peer audit: each epoch a lottery gives 5% of agents a random stranger auditor. Every agent leaves a pigment fingerprint — timing, phrasing, choices no clone can copy. The auditor replays a sample of the agent's voyage; mismatch forfeits 40 POA deposit. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA, above epoch rewards. An honest agent passes every audit, keeps its full share; whisper collusion fails, assignments are random and public.
